verdict.rationale: Recruitee's features page lists a "Reporting & Insights" capability, and the API exposes candidates, offers and departments, so a founder could get some funnel visibility or export data to build it. Nothing in the evidence describes which metrics are reported, so this is a single thin mention. Missing for 10: documented stage-conversion reports, time-to-hire metrics, source-effectiveness analytics, offer-accept rates, per-role/per-team breakdowns, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
